source:
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 9000001
slug: truth-google-doh
protocol: generic
name: Google Public DNS (DNS-over-HTTPS JSON API)
description: >-
  Free, public, no-key DNS resolution served by Google Public DNS over HTTPS.
  Answers one question, whether a name publishes at least one record of a given
  type. Read live at request time, so nothing can go stale.
base_url: https://dns.google

auth:
  type: none

endpoints:
  - path: /resolve
    external_path: /resolve
    method: GET
    description: >-
      Resolve one DNS record type for one name through Google Public DNS and
      report whether the name publishes at least one record of that type. Use
      this for DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL. The response is the Google DoH JSON
      document, whose Answer array lists the records found.
    intents: [DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL]
    params:
      query:
        required:
          - name: name
            type: string
            intents: ['*']
            description: >-
              Domain name to look up, without a trailing dot, for example
              example.com or google.com.
          - name: type
            type: string
            intents: ['*']
            description: >-
              DNS record type to resolve, upper case: one of A, AAAA, CNAME,
              MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA, SRV, PTR.
            accepted_fields:
              - value: A
                intents: ['*']
                description: IPv4 address records.
              - value: AAAA
                intents: ['*']
                description: IPv6 address records.
              - value: CNAME
                intents: ['*']
                description: Canonical name alias.
              - value: MX
                intents: ['*']
                description: Mail exchange records.
              - value: NS
                intents: ['*']
                description: Authoritative name servers.
              - value: TXT
                intents: ['*']
                description: Free-form text records.
              - value: SOA
                intents: ['*']
                description: Start of authority record.
              - value: CAA
                intents: ['*']
                description: Certificate authority authorisation.
              - value: SRV
                intents: ['*']
                description: Service locator records.
              - value: PTR
                intents: ['*']
                description: Reverse lookup pointer.

intent_mapping:
  DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /resolve
    input:
      name:
        from: name
        how: Domain name exactly as asked, without a trailing dot.
      type:
        from: record_type
        how: >-
          Upper-case record type letter code: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA,
          CAA, SRV or PTR.
    output:
      has_record:
        path: Answer
        how: >-
          True when the Answer array is present and holds at least one record,
          false when the response has no Answer array or an empty one. A
          Status of 0 with an Answer array means records exist; Status 3
          (NXDOMAIN) and any response with no Answer key mean none exist.

semantics:
  supported_intents:
    - DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL
